manifest.name: dsh-browser-takeover
manifest.description: 浏览器网址接管：Agent 访问网址前先查「要登录的网址」清单（web_sites），清单里的优先用 web_open 在带调试端口的浏览器里打开；同时检查登录状态、打开登录页。不保存任何账号密码。
manifest.author: L1818346

readme.text:
> 让 DSH 里的模型在你**已经登录**的浏览器里走过去：打开网址、按页面上的可见文字点一个入口；
> 同时维护一份「要登录的网址」清单——**Agent 访问网址前先查这份清单，清单里的优先走这个插件**。

---

- **GitHub 登录后仍显示"未登录"**：原来的登录判定只认学习通/B 站那套 cookie 名字
  （`SESSDATA`、`JSESSIONID`、`UID`…），GitHub 用的是 `user_session` / `logged_in` / `dotcom_user`，
  一个都不在白名单里。现在白名单补齐了 GitHub、Google、Microsoft、知乎、微博等常见名字，
  并加了一条通用规则兜底。
- **判定分两档**：命中已知名字 → `confidence: 'certain'`（界面显示"已登录"）；
  只命中通用规则（名字里有 session / sso / auth / token / ticket 且值不为空）→ `'likely'`
  （界面显示"**可能已登录**"，不冒充确定）。`logged_in` 这类开关型 cookie 按值判断，
  `logged_in=no` 不算登录。
- 反例也钉住了：GitHub 未登录时同样有 `_gh_sess`，所以通用规则刻意不收 `sess`，
  否则会把没登录的 GitHub 说成"可能已登录"。

- **清单从空开始**：不再预置任何网址，也不读别的插件留下的 `video-storyboard-sites.json`。
  装好之后清单是空的，要加什么由你自己加（设置页，或 `web_open({ …, remember: true })`）。
- **CDP 收成一个小模块** `src/cdp.js`：只留这个插件真正用到的几件事——找页面目标、
  在页面/每个 iframe 上下文里求值、读 cookie、回答端口状态、按端口拉起浏览器。
  视频时代的位置读取、封面/转码 cookie 导出等全部删掉。
- **浏览器状态只有四种**：`open`（端口已开）/ `closed`（端口不通）/ `unconfigured`（没配端口）/ `error`。
  设置页不再出现"页面里没有视频"这类词。
- **端口只认 `~/.dsh/browser.json`**（不再读 `video.json`）。
- 许可证正文保留，**版权声明行已删除**。

- **`web_sites`**：访问网址前先查一次清单——这条地址存过没有、那个浏览器此刻登录着没有。
  零副作用，不启动浏览器、不打开页面。
- **`web_open` 带上判断**：返回里始终有 `site`（清单命中：完全一致 / 同主机 / 同域名）
  与 `signIn`（登录态）；新参数 `remember` 先记进清单再打开，`launch` 端口没开就自己拉起浏览器。
- **系统提示里的约定**：Agent 访问网址时会先 `web_sites`，清单里的用 `web_open`，
  不用 `web_fetch` 抓 HTML 顶替（抓不到登录后的内容）。
- 清单匹配独立成 `src/lookup.js`（纯函数），登录态判断抽到 `src/session.js`；
  新增 `test/` 下的单元测试。**升级后需重启一次 DSH Desktop**，工具与提示词才会重新组装。

| 层 | 含义 | 界面 | 例子 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 身份 cookie | 只有登录后才出现 | **已登录** | `user_session` · `SESSDATA` · `BDUSS` · `z_c0` · `_tb_token_` · `pt_key` · `li_at` · `ESTSAUTH` · `KEYCLOAK_IDENTITY` · `__Secure-next-auth.session-token` |
| 框架会话 | 匿名访客也会拿到 | **可能已登录** | `PHPSESSID` · `JSESSIONID` · `laravel_session` · `connect.sid` · `MoodleSession` · `sid` |
| 匿名噪音 | 与登录无关，永不计数 | 不计入 | `_gh_sess` · `csrftoken` · `_ga` · `_hjSessionUser_*` · `AWSALB` · `NID` · `datr` · `color_mode` |
| 兜底规则 | 名字含 session / sso / auth / token / ticket… 且值不短 | **可能已登录** | 表里没有的站点靠它 |

表在 [src/session-cookies.js](src/session-cookies.js)，一个名字一行；遇到"登录了却显示未登录"，
把该站的 cookie 名字加进 `IDENTITY_COOKIES` 即可（`npm test` 会顺手验证没把别人带歪）。

| 能力 | 入口 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 查清单 | 工具 `web_sites` | 零副作用：这条网址存过没有、那个浏览器此刻登录着没有。不启动浏览器、不打开页面 |
| 页面导航 / 按文字点击 | 工具 `web_open` | 在带调试端口的浏览器里打开地址，按可见文字点一个元素；会搜所有 iframe |
| 网址清单 | 设置 → 浏览器网址接管 | 只存 URL 与添加时间，不存账号密码 |
| 登录状态 | 同上 | 依据该站点的**会话 cookie 名字**判断（三层表 + 兜底规则），cookie 的值不离开宿主进程 |
| 打开登录页 | 同上 | 端口开着就开新标签，没开就带调试参数启动浏览器 |

一次调用最多点**一个**元素；不做循环点击、不批量爬取。

插件往系统提示里写了一段约定（`src/prompt.js`），所以「去访问某个网址」时 Agent 会：

1. 先调 `web_sites({ url })` —— 零成本，回答这条网址在不在清单里；
2. 在清单里（`saved: true`，或 `hostSite` 命中同一站点）→ **用 `web_open` 打开**，
   而不是 `web_fetch` 抓 HTML（抓不到登录后的内容）；
3. 清单里没有 → 也优先 `web_open`；需要登录的站点先让你在那个窗口里登录一次，
   再用 `remember: true` 记进清单，下次就自动算"清单里的网址"。

`web_open` 的返回里一直带着这些判断，所以即使 Agent 直接开了工具，也看得到
「这条网址存过没有、登录着没有」：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "saved": true,
  "site": {

匹配规则：完全一样 > 同一主机（登录态同样适用）> 同注册域名（只作提示）。
比较时忽略 `www.`、末尾斜杠、query 和 hash；差异会原样回显，不替你拍板。

```bash
git clone git@github.com:L1818346/dsh-browser-takeover.git
cd dsh-browser-takeover
node scripts/install-dev.mjs     # 用 junction 挂进 desktop profile 并注册 bundle
```

然后**重启 DSH Desktop**（插件树与系统提示都在进程启动时组装；工具与提示词的改动
不重启不会生效）。装好之后**清单是空的**，没有任何预置网址——第一条要你自己加。

要求：

- Node.js ≥ 20
- Edge 或 Chrome（要能开 `--remote-debugging-port`，即 CDP）

插件不会读你的主浏览器 profile —— Chromium 136 起明确禁止在默认 profile 上开调试端口
（[官方说明](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port)），而换路径去看同一份
profile 又会因为 App-Bound Encryption 拿不到已登录的 cookie。所以它要的是**一只带调试端口
的独立窗口**，默认端口 `9333`：

```bat
scripts\start-edge-debug.cmd
```

脚本用 `~/.dsh/edge-watch` 作为独立 profile 启动 Edge，并打开调试端口。
**在这个窗口里登录一次**，之后插件都复用这份登录态；你平时的 Edge 可以照常开着。

也可以自己起：

```bat
msedge.exe --remote-debugging-port=9333 --user-data-dir="%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\edge-watch"
```

`~/.dsh/browser.json`：

```json
{
  "browserPort": 9333,
  "launchBrowser": true
}

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `browserPort` | 无 | 调试端口；工具里显式传 `browserPort` 优先，其次这个文件，最后落到 9333 |
| `launchBrowser` | `false` | 清单里的站点在端口没开时，是否允许插件自己拉起浏览器。打开后"优先走插件"才真的不用你动手 |

端口只该有一个说法。

清单初始是空的：第一条网址要么在设置页点「添加」，要么打开时顺手用 `remember: true` 记下来。

```js
// 1. 先查：这条网址存过没有？（零成本）
web_sites({ url: "https://hdu.fanya.chaoxing.com/portal" })

// 2. 再开：清单里的网址直接走插件浏览器（带登录态）

匹配规则：完全相同 > 以它开头 > 包含；`<a>` 链接在平手时优先。
匹配不到时会把候选列出来，而不是猜一个。

- 网址清单在 `~/.dsh/browser-takeover-sites.json`，只存 URL 和时间戳；**初始为空**，
  插件不预置、也不从别的文件名里捞。
- 不读、不填账号密码输入框；不导出 cookie 的**值**。设置页和 `web_sites` 只回显会话 cookie 的
  **名字**（如 `SESSDATA`、`user_session`）。唯一的例外是 `logged_in` 这类开关型 cookie：
  只拿 `yes`/`no` 做判断，值本身不外传。
- 登录状态分三档：**已登录**（命中身份 cookie）/ **可能已登录**（框架会话或兜底规则）/
  **未登录**；端口没开时是「无法判断」，而不是冒充「未登录」。判定表在
  [src/session-cookies.js](src/session-cookies.js)，名字可以自己往里加。

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `no-debug-port` | 浏览器没带调试参数启动 | 跑 `scripts\start-edge-debug.cmd`，或 `web_open({ …, launch: true })` |
| Agent 没先查清单 | 插件是在加这段提示之前加载的 | 重启 DSH Desktop |
| 设置页显示「端口未开」 | 同上，或端口不是 9333 | 检查 `browser.json` |
| 点了没反应 | 站点用 `window.open`，被弹窗拦截 | 对 `<a href>` 插件会直接导航；其余元素只能真点 |
| 登录状态「无法判断」 | 浏览器没开，读不到 cookie | 先启动调试浏览器 |
| 明明登录了却显示「未登录」 | 该站的登录 cookie 名字不在 [src/session-cookies.js](src/session-cookies.js) 的 `IDENTITY_COOKIES` 里 | 把名字加进那个数组；兜底规则一般会先兜成「可能已登录」 |
| 显示「可能已登录」 | 只命中框架会话（`PHPSESSID` 等）或兜底规则 | 一般就是登录了；想更确定就把名字加进 `IDENTITY_COOKIES` |
| 没登录却说「已登录」 | 某个匿名 cookie 被当成了身份 cookie | 把名字挪进 `ANONYMOUS_COOKIES`，并补一条测试 |

```bash
npm run check     # 逐文件 node --check（含 client.js 与 test/）
npm test          # node --test：清单匹配与系统提示段的单元测试
npm run smoke     # 用假的 defineTool 跑一遍 apply()，并真的执行两个工具（不碰浏览器）
```

`npm test` 会 fork 子进程；如果你的环境禁止 fork（某些沙箱），直接跑
`node test/lookup.test.mjs` 也能执行（同一进程内）。

> Walk the browser you are **already signed in to**: open a URL, click one entry by its visible
> text, keep a list of login-gated sites — and let the agent **look that list up before it visits
> any URL**, preferring this plugin for the sites it saved.

---

The sign-in table grows from "a handful of sites" into **three tiers** covering the common
platforms, frameworks and SSO providers:

| Tier | Meaning | Badge | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| Identity cookie | only exists once signed in | **Signed in** | `user_session` · `SESSDATA` · `BDUSS` · `z_c0` · `_tb_token_` · `pt_key` · `li_at` · `ESTSAUTH` · `KEYCLOAK_IDENTITY` · `__Secure-next-auth.session-token` |
| Framework session | also handed to anonymous visitors | **Probably signed in** | `PHPSESSID` · `JSESSIONID` · `laravel_session` · `connect.sid` · `MoodleSession` · `sid` |
| Anonymous noise | unrelated to login, never counted | ignored | `_gh_sess` · `csrftoken` · `_ga` · `_hjSessionUser_*` · `AWSALB` · `NID` · `datr` · `color_mode` |
| Fallback rule | name carries session / sso / auth / token / ticket… and a non-trivial value | **Probably signed in** | everything not in the tables |

The table lives in [src/session-cookies.js](src/session-cookies.js), one name per line: when a site
that is signed in reads as "not signed in", add its cookie name to `IDENTITY_COOKIES` (`npm test`
then proves you did not break the negative cases).

- **GitHub showed "not signed in" after logging in.** The known-cookie list only carried the
  Chaoxing/Bilibili names (`SESSDATA`, `JSESSIONID`, `UID`, …); GitHub uses `user_session` /
  `logged_in` / `dotcom_user`. The list now covers GitHub, Google, Microsoft, Zhihu, Weibo and
  friends, plus a generic rule for everything else.
- **Two confidence levels**: a known name → `certain` ("Signed in"); only the generic rule →
  `likely` ("Probably signed in"), which is never presented as certainty. Switch cookies such as
  `logged_in` are checked by value (`logged_in=no` is not a login).
- The negative case is pinned too: a signed-out GitHub still carries `_gh_sess`, so the generic rule
  deliberately ignores `sess` — otherwise a signed-out GitHub would read as "probably signed in".

- **The list starts empty** — no preset URL, and no reading another plugin's
  `video-storyboard-sites.json`. You add the first site yourself (the settings page, or
  `web_open({ …, remember: true })`).
- **The CDP layer is one small module**, `src/cdp.js`: list page targets, evaluate in a page or in
  every frame context, read cookies, report the port state, launch the browser on demand. The
  video-era helpers (playback position, media cookie export) are gone.
- **Four browser states only**: `open` / `closed` / `unconfigured` / `error`.
- **The port comes from `~/.dsh/browser.json` only** (`video.json` is no longer read).
- The MIT text stays; the copyright line was removed.

- **`web_sites`** — look the saved list up before visiting: is this address saved, and is the
  browser signed in there? Side-effect free: no browser, no page.
- **`web_open` carries the answer** — its reply always includes `site` (exact / same host / same
  domain) and `signIn`; new `remember` saves the URL as it opens, `launch` starts the debug browser
  when the port is closed.
- **A system-prompt section** — the agent checks `web_sites` first and opens saved sites with
  `web_open` instead of `web_fetch` (which cannot see a logged-in page).
- Matching moved to `src/lookup.js` (pure), sign-in state to `src/session.js`, plus `test/` unit
  tests. **Restart DSH Desktop once** after upgrading: tools and the prompt are assembled at start.

| Surface | Where | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Look the list up | tool `web_sites` | side-effect free: is this URL saved, and is the browser signed in there? starts no browser, loads no page |
| Navigate / click by text | tool `web_open` | navigates and clicks ONE element in a browser started with a debug port; every frame is searched |
| Site list | Settings → Browser Session Takeover | URLs only — no credentials |
| Sign-in state | same | derived from the **names** of that site's cookies (three-tier table + fallback rule); values never leave the host |
| Open login page | same | new tab when the port is up, otherwise launches the browser with the debug flag |
At most one click per call. No loops, no bulk crawling.

readme.text:
`web_open` carries the same judgement back in its reply, so even a direct call shows whether the URL
was saved and whether the session is signed in:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "saved": true,
  "site": {

Matching: same address > same host (the login session applies too) > same registrable domain
(information only). `www.`, trailing slashes, query and hash are ignored when comparing; differences
are echoed back rather than guessed away.

```bash
git clone git@github.com:L1818346/dsh-browser-takeover.git
cd dsh-browser-takeover
node scripts/install-dev.mjs     # junction into the desktop profile + register the bundle
```

Then **restart DSH Desktop** — the plugin tree and the system prompt are composed at process start,
so tool and prompt changes need a restart. The site list **starts empty**: nothing is preset, the
first site is yours to add.

Requirements: Node.js ≥ 20 and Edge/Chrome (CDP via `--remote-debugging-port`).

The plugin does not read your everyday profile: Chromium 136+ refuses a debug port on the default
profile ([announcement](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port)), and pointing a
second browser at the same profile data cannot decrypt the existing cookies (App-Bound Encryption
binds them to the data directory). So it needs a **separate window with the debug port open**,
default `9333`:

```bat
scripts\start-edge-debug.cmd
```

That starts Edge with the dedicated profile `~/.dsh/edge-watch` and the debug port. Sign in there
once; the plugin reuses that session. Your normal Edge window is untouched.

Or start it yourself:

```bat
msedge.exe --remote-debugging-port=9333 --user-data-dir="%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\edge-watch"
```

`~/.dsh/browser.json`:

```json
{
  "browserPort": 9333,
  "launchBrowser": true
}

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `browserPort` | none | debug port; the tool argument wins, then this file, then 9333 |
| `launchBrowser` | `false` | for saved sites whose port is closed, may the plugin start the browser itself; with `true`, "prefer this plugin" needs no manual step |

One port, one answer.

The list starts empty: add the first URL on the settings page, or use `remember: true` while opening.

```js
// 1. look it up first (free, no browser)
web_sites({ url: "https://example.com/portal" })

// 2. open it through the plugin browser (already signed in)

Matching: exact > prefix > substring; links win ties. When nothing matches, candidates are returned
instead of a guess.

- Site list: `~/.dsh/browser-takeover-sites.json` — URLs and timestamps only, **empty by default**,
  with nothing preset and nothing adopted from another plugin's file.
- No credential reads/fills, no cookie **values** exported. The settings page and `web_sites` echo
  session cookie **names** only (`SESSDATA`, `user_session`, ...). The one exception is a switch
  cookie like `logged_in`: only its `yes`/`no` answer is used, never the value itself.
- Sign-in state has three levels: **signed in** (identity cookie), **probably signed in** (framework
  session or fallback rule), **not signed in**; with the port down it says "cannot tell" instead of
  pretending. The table is [src/session-cookies.js](src/session-cookies.js) — add names there.

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `no-debug-port` | browser started without the debug flag | run `scripts\start-edge-debug.cmd`, or `web_open({ …, launch: true })` |
| agent does not check the list | plugin was loaded before this section existed | restart DSH Desktop |
| settings says port closed | not running, or a different port | check `browser.json` |
| click does nothing | site uses `window.open`; popup blocked | `<a href>` entries are navigated directly; others can only be clicked |
| sign-in "cannot tell" | browser not running | start the debug browser |
| signed in but shown as "not signed in" | that site's login cookie name is missing from `IDENTITY_COOKIES` in [src/session-cookies.js](src/session-cookies.js) | add the name there; the fallback rule usually reports "probably signed in" meanwhile |
| "probably signed in" | only a framework session (`PHPSESSID`, …) or the fallback rule matched | usually it is signed in; add the name to `IDENTITY_COOKIES` to make it certain |
| "signed in" while signed out | an anonymous cookie was taken for an identity cookie | move the name to `ANONYMOUS_COOKIES` and add a test |

```bash
npm run check     # node --check per file, including client.js and test/
npm test          # node --test: matching and prompt-section unit tests
npm run smoke     # apply() against a fake defineTool, then really runs both tools (no browser)
```

`npm test` forks a child process per file; where forking is not allowed, running
`node test/lookup.test.mjs` executes the same tests in-process.
